predicates.HistoricalB3: ∀ (I J : Finset ℕ), ↑I ⊆ A → ↑J ⊆ A → I.Nonempty → J.Nonempty → I.card ≤ 3 → J.card ≤ 3 → (∑ i ∈ I, i = ∑ j ∈ J, j) → I = J
predicates.ModernB3: ∀ I J : Multiset ℕ, (∀ i ∈ I, i ∈ A) → (∀ j ∈ J, j ∈ A) → I.card = 3 → J.card = 3 → I.sum = J.sum → I = J
predicates.WeakFixed3: ∀ (I : Finset ℕ) (J : Finset ℕ), ↑I ⊆ A ∧ ↑J ⊆ A ∧ I.card = 3 ∧ J.card = 3 ∧ (∑ i ∈ I, i = ∑ j ∈ J, j) → I = J
